'''Chapter 489''' is titled "The Eighth".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: [[Usopp]] and [[Franky]] build a treehouse atop a tree coiling into a sea of clouds. While the rest of the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] are content to rest there, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], and [[Brook]] (their newest crewmate) notice all the goldfish floating around the clouds—and step into the air to see if they can float as well.

==Short Summary==
[[Brook]] becomes the newest crew member of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]. The crew rejoices over having a musician join the crew. Brook reminisces about Laboon. At the same time, in [[Twin Cape]], [[Laboon]] seems to be unusually filled with joy, as noted by [[Crocus]]. Brook bids his crew a final farewell at a grave that [[Franky]] built. Zoro also joins him as he says goodbye to his [[Yubashiri|old katana]]. Luffy announces that the crew will be heading to [[Fish-Man Island]] next. [[Charlotte Lola|Lola]] gives Nami a piece of her mother's [[Vivre Card]]. She tells Nami that it will come in handy for them in the [[New World]]. Luffy then remembers that [[Portgas D. Ace|his brother]] gave him a Vivre Card back in [[Arabasta Kingdom|Arabasta]]. He takes out the card and notices that it is burning and smaller than before. Lola, alarmed, tells Luffy that his brother's life force is fading away and that he is in danger.

==Long Summary==
[[Brook]] stopped playing the piano, revealing the historical reason for the [[Dials#Tone Dial|Tone Dial]]. He states that it was the [[Rumbar Pirates]]' [[Binks' Sake|final song]] and that he heard it so many times during the 50 years he was alone. He looks into the Tone Dial and has a flashback to one of the Rumbar parties. Brook goes on to say that the song made him feel alive and seals away into his head by lifting the top part of his cranium, shocking [[Sanji]] and [[Usopp]] while amazing [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]].

Brook states that he is overjoyed that [[Laboon]] was still alive, saying that now he had a [[Dream|goal in life]], to deliver the Tone Dial to the [[Animal Species#Island Whales|whale]]. He shouted that he was glad to be alive. He then asks Luffy the question: if it was alright if he could join the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]. Luffy simply replies with a "sure". This shocks Usopp, Sanji, [[Franky]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], horrifies [[Nami]], makes [[Nico Robin|Robin]] laugh and there is no response from [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] as he is unconscious. Nevertheless, the men from the crew welcomed their new [[musician]], saying that he was interesting. While Robin seems to enjoy the loudness, Nami comments that the Straw Hats have gathered weird crewmembers. Brook leans up against a wall at a 45 degree angle, calling it his "45 degrees", creating laughter.

Brook has a flashback to Laboon, silently talking to Laboon, that he would return and deliver the Tone Dial to Laboon.

At [[Twin Cape]], Laboon suddenly cries out in joy, making [[Crocus]] happy as Laboon was in such good spirits.

Back to [[Thriller Bark]], Brook kneels down and shows everyone a wanted poster for Humming Brook, himself. He reveals that he has a {{B}}33,000,000 [[bounty]] and that he once was a leader of a battle convoy in an [[Esperia Kingdom|unknown kingdom]] and later became [[Pirate Captain|captain]] of the Rumbar Pirates. Brook then kneels in front of Luffy, pledging his allegiance.

Two days later, Brook is in awe of the workmanship of Franky and Usopp as they had made a grave for the Rumbar Pirates. Franky states the Rumbar Pirate corpses could not be taken aboard the [[Thousand Sunny]], so they constructed the grave. Brook also reveals that Thriller Bark came from the Rumbar Pirates' [[West Blue|home seas]], and with that, maybe the fallen [[pirate]]s could be at peace easier. As Brook plays some music in front of the grave, Zoro sits down next to him, plunging his [[Famous Blade#50 Skillful Grade Blades|sword]], [[Yubashiri]], into the ground, stating that he was holding a small funeral for a dead [[Sword#Katana|katana]]. Brook tells Zoro that he has joined the crew. Zoro comments that Brook had bad luck and that the crew was varied. Brook simply laughs and says that he would devote everything.

The Straw Hat Pirates begin to leave and say their goodbyes. Franky tells [[Charlotte Lola|Lola]] that he had fixed [[Rumbar Pirates#Second Ship|Brook's ship]], so they could use that to sail. Lola asks Franky to [[Marriage|marry]] her, but Franky says that he is too super and it would not be a good match. Luffy gets excited at the prospect of going to [[Fish-Man Island]] while Brook and Sanji have their own perverted views. The tall [[Risky Brothers|Risky Brother]] reveals that [[Merfolk|mermaids]] did not wear panties but their beauty was even greater than the pirate empress [[Boa Hancock|Hancock]]. Usopp asks the short Risky Brother how they knew so much and it is discovered that [[Rolling Pirates|Lola's pirates]] had passed through Fish-Man Island as they had originated from the [[New World]]. Lola says that her [[Charlotte Linlin|mother]] was a pirate. Remembering something, Lola rips apart a piece of paper and hands one half to Nami, saying that it was a [[Vivre Card]] and she gave it to Nami as they were like sisters. Apparently, Lola's mother is a [[Four Emperors|famous pirate]] in the New World and Nami is advised to look after the Vivre Card.

Nami asks what a Vivre Card is. Lola tells her that they only worked in the New World and that it would never burn or get wet. Lola states that if you took a fingernail to a certain shop, they would create a special paper. She goes on and says that you tear the paper up and give it to a special person. Lola places the Vivre Card on a desk and it jumps. She reveals the main point of a Vivre Card, saying that it would allow you to meet with the special person. Lola says that if they ever had a problem, they could go to her mother for help.

Luffy, in deep thought, states that he had a similar sort of paper and Nami agrees. In a flashback, [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] is seen saying that the paper would let them meet again. Luffy retrieves the card from his hat and notices it burning and getting smaller. Lola then says that the paper was a representation of the person's life. Luffy tells her that it came from Ace and she states that his life was vanishing by the minute.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Brook]] officially joins the crew and becomes the ninth crew member of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]].
**Brook's [[bounty]] is revealed to be {{B}}33,000,000.
**He once was a leader of a battle convoy in an [[Esperia Kingdom|unknown kingdom]].
*The [[Rumbar Pirates]] finally rest in peace at a gravesite on [[Thriller Bark]]. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] also puts his old [[Famous Blade#50 Skillful Grade Blades|sword]], [[Yubashiri]], to rest there as well.
*The Pirate Empress [[Boa Hancock]] is mentioned for the first time.
*Franky repairs the [[pirate]] [[ship]] for the Rumbar Pirates and gives it to the [[Rolling Pirates]] to sail from Thriller Bark.
*[[Charlotte Lola|Lola]] and her [[Rolling Pirates|crew]] are revealed to be from the [[New World]].
**Lola mentions that her [[Charlotte Linlin|mother]], a [[Four Emperors|great pirate]], will help out the Straw Hats when they meet in the New World.
*[[Vivre Card]]s are explained for the first time.
**Lola gives her mother's Vivre Card to [[Nami]].
**The piece of paper [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] gave to [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] during the [[Arabasta Arc]] is revealed to be a Vivre Card as well. It is shown to be burning out, signaling that he is dying or in great danger.
*This is the last chapter of the [[Thriller Bark Arc]] and the [[Thriller Bark Saga]].
*This chapter continues the motif (last used in [[Chapter 439]]) of titling select chapters after the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]' joining order.
